---
title: "Aligned faceted supplementary composition panels"
format: html
---

Display-only revision. Retained 16S return and approved viral composition values;
no abundance filtering or statistical reanalysis. Family palette transcribed
from the retained PDF legend, in the archived table's family order.

```{r}
library(data.table);library(ggplot2);library(cowplot);library(grid)
source("R/figure_style.R")
root<-"/Users/shaman.narayanasamy/Work/data/phage_uv_treatment/PRJEB79569/derived"
out<-commandArgs(TRUE)[1];stopifnot(!dir.exists(out));dir.create(out,recursive=TRUE)
fpath<-file.path(root,"16s_analysis/09_return_package/16s_family_profile_long.tsv")
vpath<-file.path(root,"supplementary_votu_compact_2026-09-23-v1/plotted_values.tsv")
f<-fread(fpath);v<-fread(vpath)
families<-unique(f$family)
cols<-c("#4E79A7","#9C7560","#E15759","#76B7B2","#59A14F","#17BECF","#B07AA1","#FF9DA7","#9C7560","#17BECF","#1B9E77","#D95F02","#7570B3","#F28E2B","#66A61E","#A6761D","#8DA0CB","#E78AC3","#A6D854","#FFD92F","#BC80BD","#80B1D3","#FB8072","#B3DE69","#FCCDE5","#D9D9D9","#969696")
stopifnot(length(families)==length(cols),uniqueN(f$sample_title)==12,uniqueN(v$sample)==12)
cols[cols=="#9C7560"]<-"#9C755F"
f[,family:=factor(family,levels=families)]
f[,condition:=factor(condition,levels=c("control","treatment"),labels=c("Control","Treatment"))]
positions<-as.vector(rbind(paste0("C",1:3,"-I"),paste0("C",1:3,"-BF")))
f[,position:=factor(paste0("C",cycle,"-",ifelse(phase=="initial","I","BF")),levels=positions)]
v[,position:=factor(position,levels=positions)]
v[,condition:=factor(condition,levels=c("Control","Treatment"))]
stopifnot(all(abs(f[,sum(relative_abundance),by=sample_title]$V1-1)<1e-5),all(abs(v[,sum(proportion),by=sample]$V1-1)<1e-10))
base<-function(d,y,fill,ylab,tag){
 ggplot(d,aes(x=position,y=.data[[y]],fill=.data[[fill]]))+geom_col(width=.68)+
 facet_grid(condition~.)+scale_x_discrete(drop=FALSE,expand=expansion(add=.5))+
 scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(0,1,.25),labels=scales::label_percent(),expand=expansion(mult=0))+coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,1))+
 labs(x="Cleaning cycle and sampling phase",y=ylab,tag=tag)+
 theme_classic(base_size=10)+theme(strip.background=element_rect(fill="#F3F3F3",colour=NA),
 strip.text.y=element_text(size=10),panel.spacing.y=unit(10,"pt"),
 plot.tag=element_text(face="bold",size=12),legend.position="right",legend.text=element_text(size=9),
 legend.title=element_text(size=10),legend.key.size=unit(11,"pt"),legend.spacing.y=unit(1,"pt"),
 plot.margin=margin(7,8,7,7))
}
p1<-base(f,"relative_abundance","family","Relative abundance\n(16S reads)","A")+
 scale_fill_manual(values=setNames(cols,families),name="Family",drop=FALSE)+guides(fill=guide_legend(ncol=1))
p2<-base(v,"proportion","realm","Relative abundance\n(vOTU-mapped MG reads)","B")+
 scale_fill_manual(values=phage_uv_viral_realm_colours,name="Viral realm",drop=FALSE)+guides(fill=guide_legend(ncol=1))
l1<-get_legend(p1);l2<-get_legend(p2)
g<-align_plots(p1+theme(legend.position="none"),p2+theme(legend.position="none"),align="v",axis="lr")
stopifnot(length(g[[1]]$widths)==length(g[[2]]$widths))
shared_widths<-unit.pmax(g[[1]]$widths,g[[2]]$widths)
g[[1]]$widths<-shared_widths;g[[2]]$widths<-shared_widths
stopifnot(identical(g[[1]]$widths,g[[2]]$widths))
draw<-function(){grid.newpage();pushViewport(viewport(layout=grid.layout(2,2,widths=unit(c(.70,.30),"null"),heights=unit(c(.60,.40),"null"))))
 for(i in 1:2){pushViewport(viewport(layout.pos.row=i,layout.pos.col=1));grid.draw(g[[i]]);popViewport();pushViewport(viewport(layout.pos.row=i,layout.pos.col=2));grid.draw(if(i==1)l1 else l2);popViewport()};popViewport()}
pdf(file.path(out,"aligned-composition.pdf"),width=8.5,height=9,useDingbats=FALSE);draw();dev.off()
ragg::agg_png(file.path(out,"preview.png"),width=1530,height=1620,res=180);draw();dev.off()
fwrite(f,file.path(out,"16s_plotted_values.tsv"),sep="\t");fwrite(v,file.path(out,"viral_plotted_values.tsv"),sep="\t")
fwrite(data.table(family=families,colour=cols),file.path(out,"family_palette.tsv"),sep="\t")
writeLines(c("PASS: unchanged archived abundance values; 12 samples per assay; sums verified.","PASS: identical aligned gtable widths, x-axis levels, expansion and bar widths; both use condition facets.",vapply(c(fpath,vpath),function(x)paste(x,digest::digest(file=x,algo="sha256")),character(1))),file.path(out,"CHECKS.txt"))
```
